items.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say

sentences.en: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say.
sentences.zh: 官员说，法国的公共汽车撞车事故造成两人死亡。

sentences.en: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
sentences.zh: 地方当局表示，一名儿童和一名年轻成人在坠机事件中丧生，更多人受伤。

items.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval

sentences.en: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval.
sentences.zh: 在联邦机构批准后，法官阻止建造特朗普的巨型拱门。

sentences.en: The Trump administration had hoped the construction of the 250-foot arch could begin as early as this week.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府曾希望这座250英尺高的拱门最早能在本周开始建造。

items.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines

sentences.en: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines.
sentences.zh: 新一波炸弹威胁袭击了欧洲航空公司。

sentences.en: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
sentences.zh: 在针对航空公司的威胁和针对媒体的威胁之间没有建立联系。

items.title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats

sentences.en: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats.
sentences.zh: 欧洲航班和广播公司成为另一波炸弹威胁的目标。

sentences.en: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week.
sentences.zh: 欧洲各地的官员报告了一系列针对多架航班的炸弹威胁，此前一连串的恶作剧导致本周航班改道。

sentences.en: Three broadcasters also received threats.
sentences.zh: 三家广播公司也受到威胁。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Andreea Alexandru)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Andreea Alexandru ）

items.title: Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children

sentences.en: Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚末日派领导人因谋杀190名儿童而被判入狱200年。

sentences.en: Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.
sentences.zh: 保罗·麦肯齐（ Paul Mackenzie ）因追随者被命令饿死自己和家人而被定罪。肯尼亚末日教派的领导人因在近代历史上世界上最严重的邪教灾难之一中谋杀190名儿童和一名成人而被判处200年徒刑。

sentences.en: The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa found the cult leader guilty of the crimes.
sentences.zh: 在肯尼亚沿海城市蒙巴萨的法院判定该邪教领袖犯有罪行两周后，该判决包括100年的饥饿谋杀罪和100年的直接杀人罪。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason

sentences.en: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason.
sentences.zh: 坦桑尼亚反对派领导人被判犯有煽动骚乱罪，但被宣告叛国罪无罪。

sentences.en: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
sentences.zh: 这位58岁的老人自去年4月以来一直被拘留，他说这些指控是出于政治动机。

items.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison

sentences.en: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚世界末日邪教组织的领导人被判处200年监禁。

sentences.en: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.
sentences.zh: 邪教领袖保罗·麦肯齐（ Paul Mackenzie ）在命令他的追随者饿死自己以迎接耶稣后，被判谋杀190名儿童和一名成人。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Brian Inganga)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Brian Inganga ）

items.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people

sentences.en: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚末日邪教领袖因谋杀191人被判终身监禁。

sentences.en: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".
sentences.zh: 保罗·麦肯齐（ Paul Mackenzie ）命令他的追随者在森林里饿死他们的孩子，这样他们就可以“遇见耶稣”。

items.title: Anti-fire ant eradication activist convicted after using legal arguments ‘similar to sovereign citizens’

sentences.en: Anti-fire ant eradication activist convicted after using legal arguments ‘similar to sovereign citizens’.
sentences.zh: 反火蚁活动家在使用“类似于主权公民”的法律论据后被定罪。

sentences.en: Legal expert compares Trevor Hold’s failed defence to ‘tried and tested argument’ used by sovereign citizen movement Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Queensland leader of a group opposing the eradication of fire ants in Australia has been convicted of obstructing government officers, after a magistrate threw out his argument that the commonwealth-funded program is illegal.
sentences.zh: 法律专家将Trevor Hold失败的辩护与主权公民运动使用的“经过考验的论点”进行了比较。获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客反对在澳大利亚消灭火蚁的团体的昆士兰州领导人因妨碍政府官员而被定罪，此前一名地方法官驳回了他的论点，即联邦资助的计划是非法的。

sentences.en: Trevor Hold was fined $1,500 but a conviction was not recorded.
sentences.zh: Trevor Hold被罚款$ 1,500 ，但未记录定罪。

sentences.en: Hold has described himself as an “ultrapreneur”, a mental health counsellor, an organic cattle farmer and the chief executive officer of the anti-program group the Australian Advocacy Group – and as self-employed.
sentences.zh: Hold将自己描述为“超级企业家”、心理健康顾问、有机养牛农民和反计划组织澳大利亚倡导组织（ Australian Advocacy Group ）的首席执行官，以及自营职业者。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: The post-quantum future of web privacy

sentences.en: The post-quantum future of web privacy.
sentences.zh: 后量子时代网络隐私的未来。

sentences.en: The highest priorities for the transition to post-quantum cryptography are the basic building blocks of authenticated key-agreement protocols such as TLS.
sentences.zh: 向后量子加密过渡的最高优先级是经过身份验证的密钥协议（如TLS ）的基本构建块。

sentences.en: Without these building blocks in place, secure communication on the Internet will not be possible once cryptographically relevant quantum computers come online.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这些构建模块，一旦加密相关的量子计算机上线，互联网上的安全通信将不可能实现。

sentences.en: However, today we rely on quantum-vulnerable cryptography for much more than TLS.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天我们对量子漏洞密码学的依赖远远超过了TLS。

sentences.en: Privacy Pass is a protocol used by site operators like Cloudflare to help protect applications from abuse.
sentences.zh: 隐私通行证是Cloudflare等网站运营商用来帮助保护应用程序免受滥用的协议。

sentences.en: One way we do this is by rate limiting individual clients so that no one client consumes too many of the site's resources.
sentences.zh: 我们这样做的一种方法是限制单个客户的速率，这样就不会有一个客户消耗太多的网站资源。

sentences.en: Normally this involves some combination of friction or loss of privacy for users: CAPTCHAs or other challenges to moderate traffic, along with accounts and fingerprinting to identify traffic.Privacy Pass was designed to avoid this tradeoff between friction and privacy.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，这涉及摩擦或用户隐私丧失的某些组合： CAPTCHA或其他限制流量的挑战，以及识别流量的帐户和指纹。隐私通行证旨在避免摩擦和隐私之间的权衡。

sentences.en: The basic idea is that a client gets issued a number of tokens , which they can redeem in exchange for access to the site.
sentences.zh: 基本思想是客户获得大量代币，他们可以兑换这些代币以换取对网站的访问权限。

sentences.en: Crucially, each token is unlinkable to the client it was issued to, ensuring the client can use the site as they always had without sacrificing privacy.

With 10 years of deployment experience under our belts — using Privacy Pass for applications such as privacy proxies (like iCloud Private Relay) and relays (like Privacy Gateway) — we, along with others , are collaborating to bring the next generation of this technology to the web.
One of our goals is to develop more sophisticated tools for managing agentic traffic that would otherwise consume too many resources and degrade performance for human visitors.
Another goal is to foster a more open ecosystem by making it easier for more types of clients to participate.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro battles to remain relevant as he speaks at rightwing conference at Mar-a-Lago

sentences.en: Flávio Bolsonaro battles to remain relevant as he speaks at rightwing conference at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）在海湖庄园（ Mar-a-Lago ）的右翼会议上发表讲话，努力保持相关性。

sentences.en: Far-right politician addresses Conservative Political Action Conference and makes unsubstantiated claims about election fraud Flávio Bolsonaro, the far-right politician who lost Brazil’s presidential election last month, has insisted his defeat is not “the end for Brazil” as he battles to maintain political relevance after fleeing to the US.
sentences.zh: 极右翼政客在保守党政治行动会议上发表讲话，并就选举舞弊提出未经证实的指控。上个月在巴西总统大选中落败的极右翼政客弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）坚称，他的失败并不是“巴西的终结” ，因为他在逃往美国后努力保持政治相关性。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro absconded early last week shortly after losing the 25 October election to the leftwing incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by more than 4m votes.
sentences.zh: 在10月25日的选举中，博尔索纳罗以超过400万张选票输给了左翼现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Russian extremist group denies sending hoax bomb threats

sentences.en: Russian extremist group denies sending hoax bomb threats.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯极端主义组织否认发送恶作剧炸弹威胁。

sentences.en: Scores of flights across Europe have received bomb threats this week, but no explosives have been found so far.
sentences.zh: 本周，欧洲各地的数十架航班都收到了炸弹威胁，但到目前为止还没有发现爆炸物。

items.title: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted

sentences.en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted.
sentences.zh: ANC在南非地方选举中面临严重的失败， 80 ％的选票被清点。

sentences.en: Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.
sentences.zh: 前解放运动在全国选票中所占的份额比2021年的结果低近14个百分点非洲人国民大会在南非的地方选举中遭遇了严重的失败，曾经占主导地位的纳尔逊·曼德拉党在全国范围内落后于三分之一的选票，超过80 ％的选票被计算在内。

sentences.en: Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994.
sentences.zh: 周三的分散投票标志着非国大衰落的另一个阶段，自1994年白人少数种族隔离统治结束以来，非国大一直领导着各国政府。

sentences.en: High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to voters turning away from the party .
sentences.zh: 高失业率、犯罪率、腐败和当地服务质量低下都导致选民退党。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis

sentences.en: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 气候危机前线的难民“无处可逃”。

sentences.en: The climate emergency is an immediate crisis for refugees, with three in four – nearly 90 million people – living in countries facing high to severe exposure to hazards such as drought, floods and extreme heat.
sentences.zh: 气候紧急情况对难民来说是一个紧迫的危机，四分之三（近9000万人）生活在面临严重干旱、洪水和极端高温等危险的国家。

items.title: Sudan’s suffering is plain for all to see say aid teams, as brutal war continues

sentences.en: Sudan’s suffering is plain for all to see say aid teams, as brutal war continues.
sentences.zh: 随着野蛮战争的继续，苏丹的苦难对所有人来说都是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Aid teams working to help millions of people uprooted by the ongoing war in Sudan appealed on Friday for more international assistance amid desperate funding shortages, empty warehouses and overwhelming needs.
sentences.zh: 在资金严重短缺、仓库空置和需求巨大的情况下，致力于帮助因苏丹战争而背井离乡的数百万人的援助团队周五呼吁提供更多的国际援助。

items.title: From a ship frozen into Arctic ice, a warning to world leaders: Trust the science

sentences.en: From a ship frozen into Arctic ice, a warning to world leaders: Trust the science.
sentences.zh: 从一艘冻结在北极冰层中的船上，向世界各国领导人发出警告：相信科学。

sentences.en: Drifting through the polar darkness, a team of scientists is documenting a rapidly changing Arctic.
sentences.zh: 在极地黑暗中漂流，一组科学家正在记录迅速变化的北极。

sentences.en: As sea ice retreats and oil tankers move in, a conversation with the UN chief reveals why the battle for climate science matters far beyond the North Pole.
sentences.zh: 随着海冰撤退和油轮驶入，与联合国负责人的对话揭示了为什么气候科学的战斗远远超出了北极。

items.title: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force

sentences.en: World News in Brief: Civilians killed in DR Congo, Ukrainians wrestle with return, Guterres calls out ‘normalisation’ of force.
sentences.zh: 世界新闻简报：古特雷斯呼吁武力“正常化” ，刚果民主共和国平民丧生，乌克兰人为回归而挣扎。

sentences.en: At least 30 civilians were killed overnight on Thursday in Beni Territory, North Kivu in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to local sources cited by the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).
sentences.zh: 据联合国援助协调办公室（ OCHA ）援引的当地消息来源称，周四晚上在刚果民主共和国北基伍省贝尼地区至少有30名平民被杀。

items.title: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions

sentences.en: Afghanistan faces deepening humanitarian crisis amid sweeping rights restrictions.
sentences.zh: 在广泛的权利限制下，阿富汗面临着日益严重的人道主义危机。

sentences.en: Afghanistan stands at a “difficult crossroad” more than five years after the Taliban returned to power, a senior UN official said on Friday.
sentences.zh: 一名联合国高级官员周五表示，在塔利班重新掌权五年多后，阿富汗正处于“艰难的十字路口”。

sentences.en: Relative stability and security are being undercut by a fragile economy, sweeping curbs on rights and acute humanitarian need.
sentences.zh: 脆弱的经济、对权利的全面限制和迫切的人道主义需求正在削弱相对稳定和安全。

items.title: Low pressure in US midwest brings unseasonable heat to New York and Boston

sentences.en: Low pressure in US midwest brings unseasonable heat to New York and Boston.
sentences.zh: 美国中西部的低压给纽约和波士顿带来了不合时宜的炎热。

sentences.en: Further south this week, severe thunderstorms affected midterms voting in Florida, Oklahoma and Colorado Despite the rapid descent into autumn in the northern hemisphere, parts of eastern North America have experienced an exceptionally late taste of summer in recent days.
sentences.zh: 本周进一步向南，严重的雷暴影响了佛罗里达州、俄克拉荷马州和科罗拉多州的中期投票。尽管北半球迅速下降到秋季，但北美东部的部分地区最近几天经历了异常晚的夏季。

sentences.en: Temperatures approached 23C (73F) in New York and Boston, about 7-10C above what is expected in early November.
sentences.zh: 纽约和波士顿的气温接近23摄氏度（ 73华氏度） ，比11月初的预期高出约7-10摄氏度。

sentences.en: The unseasonable warmth spilled into parts of eastern Canada, with temperatures exceeding 20C, about 10-15C above normal for the time of year.
sentences.zh: 不合时宜的温度溢入加拿大东部的部分地区，气温超过20摄氏度，一年中比正常时间高出约10-15摄氏度。

sentences.en: The balmy conditions were caused by an area of low pressure in the US midwest, dragging up exceptionally warm air from the Gulf of Mexico along its eastern flank.
sentences.zh: 温暖的条件是由美国中西部的低压地区造成的，沿着其东部侧翼从墨西哥湾拖动了异常温暖的空气。

sentences.en: This area of low pressure will gradually drift eastwards, allowing temperatures to fall closer to the average.
sentences.zh: 这个低压区域将逐渐向东漂移，使温度更接近平均值。

sentences.en: Further south, severe thunderstorms have resulted in numerous flood warnings and evacuation warnings being issued this week across many states, with disruptive weather affecting polling stations in Florida, Oklahoma and Colorado.
sentences.zh: 再往南，严重的雷暴导致本周许多州发布了许多洪水警告和疏散警告，佛罗里达州、俄克拉荷马州和科罗拉多州的投票站受到破坏性天气的影响。

sentences.en: The powerful thunderstorms even resulted in a tornado touching down in Keyes, Oklahoma, forcing the relocation of a polling station.
sentences.zh: 强大的雷暴甚至导致俄克拉荷马州凯斯的龙卷风袭击，迫使投票站搬迁。

sentences.en: The tornado caused extensive damage, although no causalities have been reported.
sentences.zh: 龙卷风造成了广泛的破坏，尽管没有人员伤亡的报道。

sentences.en: Officials across many states have requested federal funding assistance after the extreme weather resulted in widespread damage to homes and infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 在极端天气导致房屋和基础设施普遍受损后，许多州的官员都要求联邦提供资金援助。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis

sentences.en: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis.
sentences.zh: 在政治危机中，索马里最高法院驳回了总统的任期延长。

sentences.en: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.
sentences.zh: 该国自1969年以来的首次全国性选举将于明年举行，这一时间表现在令人怀疑。

items.title: Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis

sentences.en: Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis.
sentences.zh: 在数百万人的储蓄在银行危机中被冻结后，巴拉圭总统辞职。

sentences.en: Santiago Peña’s rightwing administration had authorised Ueno Bank to drastically expand operations before collapse Paraguay’s rightwing president, Santiago Peña, resigned on Thursday after a political and financial crisis collapsed the South American country’s banking system in recent days.
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥·佩尼亚（ Santiago Peña ）的右翼政府已授权上野银行（ Ueno Bank ）大幅扩张业务，直到巴拉圭右翼总统圣地亚哥·佩尼亚（ Santiago Peña ）在最近几天政治和金融危机导致南美国家银行系统崩溃后于周四辞职。

sentences.en: At the centre of the crisis is Ueno Bank, which in just a few years under Peña went from an obscure digital bank to one of the country’s largest lenders, claiming to have about 60% of Paraguay’s adult population as customers.
sentences.zh: 危机的核心是上野银行，该银行在短短几年内从一家不起眼的数字银行转变为该国最大的银行之一，声称拥有巴拉圭约60 ％的成年人口作为客户。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery

sentences.en: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery.
sentences.zh: 肺癌手术后， Pope开始了长时间的拉丁美洲之旅。

sentences.en: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
sentences.zh: 上个月切除部分肺的教皇利奥将访问乌拉圭，阿根廷和秘鲁。

items.title: Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture

sentences.en: Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture.
sentences.zh: 在GitHub的新Git存储架构中。

sentences.en: Last week at GitHub Universe, we announced our new Git storage architecture, capable of handling thousands of writes per second with reads that scale on demand.
sentences.zh: 上周在GitHub Universe上，我们宣布了新的Git存储架构，能够每秒处理数千次写入，并按需扩展读取。

sentences.en: Through internal testing, we ve demonstrated the ability to support 5,000 concurrent agents working on a repository, sending 7,200 pushes per second to a repo, all while serving read traffic with consistently low latency.
sentences.zh: 通过内部测试，我们展示了支持5,000个并发代理在存储库上工作的能力，每秒向存储库发送7,200次推送，同时始终以低延迟提供读取流量。

sentences.en: This new architecture is the foundation for GitHub to support agentic development for hundreds of millions of developers, and we ve been building it underneath GitHub while it keeps running.
sentences.zh: 这种新架构是GitHub支持数亿开发人员的代理开发的基础，我们一直在GitHub下构建它，同时它继续运行。

sentences.en: Over the past year, agents changed what a busy repository looks like on GitHub.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年中，代理改变了GitHub上繁忙的存储库的样子。

sentences.en: In our first post in this series, we laid out the two principles behind our next-generation Git storage architecture: minimize coordination, and decouple storage from compute.
sentences.zh: 在本系列的第一篇文章中，我们列出了下一代Git存储架构背后的两个原则：最小化协调，以及将存储与计算分离。

sentences.en: In our last post , we covered the bridge: moving 99.99999% of repositories into Azure, scoping the write quorum to individual references, and standing up virtual replicas backed by Azure Blob Storage.
sentences.zh: 在我们的上一篇文章中，我们介绍了桥接：将99.99999%的存储库迁移到Azure中，将写入仲裁范围限定为单个引用，并建立由Azure Blob存储支持的虚拟副本。

sentences.en: We also left off with an observation: very little of a write needs to be ordered.
sentences.zh: 我们还留下了一个观察结果：只需要订购很少的写作。

sentences.en: Git objects are immutable and named by their contents, meaning two writers can store them at the same time without agreeing on anything.
sentences.zh: Git对象是不可变的，并按其内容命名，这意味着两个编写器可以同时存储它们，而无需就任何内容达成一致。

sentences.en: The part of a push that needs agreement is the reference update, and a reference update is tiny in comparison.
sentences.zh: 推送中需要达成一致的部分是参考更新，相比之下，参考更新很小。

sentences.en: Virtual replicas were the first step toward building around that, and the means by which we onboard repositories to the new architecture.
sentences.zh: 虚拟副本是围绕这一点构建的第一步，也是我们将存储库引入新架构的手段。

sentences.en: The rest of the architecture builds on that observation.
sentences.zh: 其余的架构建立在这一观察之上。

items.title: Agents aren’t humans (but they kinda are)

sentences.en: Agents aren’t humans (but they kinda are).
AI Agents now act on the web for millions of people.
To a Site, an Agent can take many forms.
It may be indistinguishable from a human user carrying out a task, or it might look like one visitor carrying many Users.
This removes the ability for the Site to recognize, serve, and hold accountable the user or users behind the Agent, and causes the Site to face the costs when something goes wrong.
This post argues that in order for Sites to maximize the access they provide to Agents, the ecosystem must develop new mechanisms to preserve the relationship between Sites and Users.

Traditionally, in Security and Fraud Prevention, that requires three things: Identity, Reputation, and Accountability, allowing Sites to answer: Is the person acting being truthful about who they are?
Is that person trustworthy?
And who answers for the action?
“Personal AI Agents” (“Agents” for short) are automations that take instructions from a human (“User”) and pursue a goal by controlling a cloud computer or browser.
They are usually hosted and maintained by an “Operator” as part of a managed service or consumer offering.
Examples include Muse from Meta and dots from OpenAI, and more are launching all the time.

items.title: Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub

sentences.en: Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub.
sentences.zh: 辅助功能声明现在在GitHub上有一个家。

sentences.en: Accessibility work often lives in issue trackers, contribution guidelines, audit reports, team knowledge, and conversations with users.
sentences.zh: 辅助功能工作通常存在于问题跟踪器、贡献准则、审计报告、团队知识以及与用户的对话中。

sentences.en: When that information has no predictable home, people who encounter a barrier must search for it, and maintainers lose context as contributors and project ownership change.
sentences.zh: 当该信息没有可预测的归属时，遇到障碍的人必须搜索它，并且维护者会随着贡献者和项目所有权变更而失去上下文。

sentences.en: An ACCESSIBILITY.md file, now visible on repository overview pages, gives a project one durable place to explain its accessibility goals, contributor expectations, supported environments, known limitations, and process for reporting barriers.
sentences.zh: ACCESSIBILITY.md文件现在在存储库概述页面上可见，为项目提供了一个持久的地方来解释其可访问性目标、贡献者的期望、支持的环境、已知的限制和报告障碍的流程。

sentences.en: GitHub makes accessibility statements easier to find GitHub now recognizes the ACCESSIBILITY.md file in the repository s root, .github/ directory, or docs/ directory.
sentences.zh: GitHub使辅助功能语句更容易找到GitHub现在可以识别存储库的root、.github/目录或docs/目录中的ACCESSIBILITY.md文件。

sentences.en: A repository can also inherit a statement from its organization s .github/ repository.
sentences.zh: 存储库还可以从其组织的.github/repository继承语句。

sentences.en: For public repositories, maintainers can add or propose a statement from Insights > Community Standards using a concise starter document.
sentences.zh: 对于公共存储库，维护人员可以使用简洁的入门文档，在“见解” > “社区标准”中添加或提出声明。

sentences.en: GitHub s community health files help people understand how a project works: Contribution guidelines explain how to propose changes Codes of conduct establish expectations for participation Security policies explain how to report vulnerabilities Recognizing ACCESSIBILITY.md gives accessibility information a dedicated place alongside that guidance.
sentences.zh: GitHub的社区健康文件帮助人们了解项目的运作方式：贡献指南解释了如何提出变更行为准则建立对参与的期望安全政策解释了如何报告漏洞识别ACCESSIBILITY.md为辅助功能信息提供了与该指南一起的专用位置。

sentences.en: New repositories also include an accessibility issue label by default.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，新存储库还包括辅助功能问题标签。

sentences.en: The statement explains how to report a barrier and what to expect next, while the label helps maintainers organize and track the resulting work.
sentences.zh: 该陈述解释了如何报告障碍以及接下来会发生什么，而标签可帮助维护人员组织和跟踪由此产生的工作。

sentences.en: Accessibility statements make project practices visible GitHub CLI s accessibility statement , for example, documents settings, known barriers, and workarounds.
sentences.zh: 辅助功能声明使项目实践可见GitHub CLI的辅助功能声明，例如文档设置、已知障碍和解决方案。

sentences.en: It explains why table output can be difficult to follow with a screen reader and provides a command that prints pull request numbers and titles one per line instead.
sentences.zh: 它解释了为什么使用屏幕阅读器很难跟踪表格输出，并提供了一个打印拉取请求编号和标题的命令。
